verdicts.fix: Engine: when ه follows a tatweel (or starts the fragment), do not insert the · separator; output -hu, -hā, -hum. Keep · only for a real vowelless s/k/d/t + h (as·halu).
verdicts.scope: engine only (translit); no content change. Also fixes grammar [59].formula/explanation.
verdicts.reason: Confirmed in audit/glossary-hand.txt l.166-170 (ـهُ ⟶ -·hu, ـهَا ⟶ -·hā, ـهُمْ ⟶ -·hum) and audit/grammar.txt l.2143. No s/k/d/t precedes the h, so the separator is wrong. Arabic and glosses are correct.
الصُّنْدُوق begins with the sun letter ṣād (shadda on ص), so ALA-LC with assimilation is aṣ-ṣundūq; 'al-sundūq' is both unassimilated and has s for ṣ. House style assimilates everywhere.
